Frontier Architecture Contrast

Frontier Contrast: BDH-CQ (Pathway Track)

Understanding test-time adaptation in recurrent continuous latent memory versus discrete symbolic rule induction.

ARC-AGI-1 Benchmark29.5% @ $0.0007 / task
Our Toy Implementation

Deterministic Symbolic Program Synthesis

Constructs and prunes a discrete search space of 2D affine, color, morphological, and gravity operators. Operates in <10ms with zero model parameters and complete human interpretability, but suffers from combinatorial scaling on non-affine rules.

0 ParametersDiscrete GrammarClient-Side
Reported Primary Literature (arXiv / Pathway)

150M Recurrent Latent Architecture (BDH-CQ)

A post-Transformer recurrent model that digests demonstrations into a persistent continuous latent state Sₖ without token generation, verbal chain-of-thought, or inference-time weight updates (∇W = 0). Memory overhead remains strictly O(1) per task.

150M ParametersO(1) Recurrent Latent∇W = 0 At Test Time
Recurrent Latent State Accumulator

Associative Memory Digestion Pipeline

Sequential state update without expanding context window or adjusting model weights.

Recurrence:Sₖ = U(Sₖ₋₁, Dₖ)
Current Latent StateStep 1 of 5

Initial recurrent state S₀ loaded with general inductive biases (objectness, grid topology, color conservation).

Architectural Comparison: Symbolic Synthesis vs. BDH-CQ vs. Standard LLM

DimensionOur Toy ModelBDH-CQ (Pathway)Standard LLM (e.g. GPT-4o)
Core MechanismDeterministic Symbolic Synthesis (Discrete hypothesis pruning)Recurrent Latent State Accumulation (Continuous associative attractor)Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction (Transformer attention)
Model Parameters0 parameters (Handcrafted rule synthesizer)150 Million parameters (Post-Transformer architecture)7B – 70B+ parameters (Dense or MoE)
Inference-Time AdaptationRule filter over grammarZero parameter updates (∇W = 0); purely internal recurrent state Sk updateIn-context learning via prompt KV-cache attention
Memory Scaling per DemoO(H) hypothesis pruningO(1) constant fixed latent size (recurrent state Sk preserves dimensionality)O(N²) quadratic attention KV-cache growth
Verbal Reasoning / CoTExplicit programmatic traceZero verbal chain-of-thought (pure non-verbal latent processing)Extensive verbal chain-of-thought required for spatial reasoning
Cost & ARC-AGI-1 BenchmarkFree (Client-side <10ms)29.5% Accuracy @ $0.0007 / task (Pathway primary literature)15% – 35% Accuracy @ $0.10 – $3.00 / task (Significant API overhead)
Noise RobustnessBrittle (Single cell error can invalidate hypothesis)Graceful continuous degradation in latent manifoldSensitive to prompt formatting and grid tokenization bugs
